integrity: Original pair counts derive from a complete interval case partition. The independently implemented finite-map checker enumerates all pairs through dimension 12. The infinite identity relies on the written proof, and independent audit is not performed.
limitations: Formula applies to integer consecutive-diagonal interval rook monoids, not the full symmetric inverse monoid; priority comparison did not access the full Konieczny (2020) article or the full finite-chain isometry paper.
title: Commuting-pair polynomial and a three-tenths law for consecutive-diagonal rook monoids
